entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: The notice put forth by these so-called[n]Phantom Thieves is absolutely groundless.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: It is nothing more than a wicked terrorist[n]act, aimed at obstructing the elections.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: What we need now is a powerful,[n]unyielding leader. I am willing to[n]risk my life to fight them.

entries.speaker: Businessman
entries.en: Which one is right: Shido or the Phantom[n]Thieves?

entries.speaker: Plump Housewife
entries.en: I hear what Shido-san is saying, but is it[n]true?

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: I speak now to those who call themselves[n]Phantom Thieves. Your actions are gravely[n]serious crimes.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: You are rebelling against the laws of this[n]country and unnecessarily causing alarm[n]among its citizens.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: I call on you to surrender yourselves at[n]once and apologize to the people of this[n]proud nation.

entries.speaker: Gaudy Young Man
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves cut into a live[n]broadcast signal, didn't they? They're[n]crazy...

entries.speaker: Flashy Girl
entries.en: But don't you think that Shido looks like[n]a criminal too?

entries.speaker: Businessman
entries.en: I don't know what to believe anymore...

entries.speaker: Plump Housewife
entries.en: I hope they catch them soon...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That bastard Shido's tryin' to act all calm,[n]but he's prolly freakin' out on the inside.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Who is the real criminal here?
